How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your Vitamin C Serum for the very first time is super simple!
1. Start with Clean Skin: Wash your face thoroughly with a mild cleanser using lukewarm water, and gently pat dry.
2. Dispense & Tap: Dispense 1 to 2 drops onto your fingertips. Gently tap (don't rub or pull) the serum onto your cheeks, forehead, chin, and neck for about 30 seconds to help it sink in.
3. Let It Absorb: Allow it to absorb completely for 1–2 minutes. A slight tingling sensation is completely normal—it just means the bio-active ingredients are working!
Alessandra
4. Lock It In: Follow up with your favorite moisturizer and SPF in the morning.
Your Skin Care Advisor
First-Timer Tip: Since it's your first time using a Vitamin C product, start by applying it once a day or every other day so your skin can comfortably adjust before moving to daily use.
